desc: Define a Fenwick tree (BIT) class with `update` (add delta at index) and `query` (prefix sum) methods.
Read N and the permutation P, and build `where[v]` = 0-based index of value v in P.
Initialize BIT of size N with all ones, set total cost to 0.
For v from N down to 1:
Compute pos = BIT.query(where[v] + 1)  # 1-indexed position in compressed array
Add cost = (pos + v - 1) * (v - pos) // 2 to total
Print the total cost to stdout.
